human_cases.evidence_reference: None of the art exists in a form a mint will accept. What we have is six reference sheets, the crest and five event badges, printed at different times on different paper and photographed on a workbench under whatever light was in the garage. A member also sent a photo of the crest as it is embroidered on the club jackets. The mint requirements file gives diameters, the hard enamel colour ceiling, plating options and the rule that the coin's raised metal version must be line only.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
